needs.premise: Decomposed intent/CAS/data/log/locator/root/commit actions, one owner/helper and one GC; registered source and verified stop receipts external; bounded sampling not exhaustive or native proof.
Selective first-admission, split writer-stop, idempotent private repair, moved-root preservation and recycling laws; not complete QNT/source/C induction.

VM root ports precede Scheme payload/processor exposure. CFUN full frame, main startup exclusive root publication, worker rooted startup descriptor and fresh-host registered source have distinct receipts; marker allocation comes later.

Fixed origin journal records candidate/expected header/token before ownership CAS. Unknown response retains intent/source; only full control-stop and data-stop allow authoritative header reconciliation; never mutate competing owner.

Separate actual metadata stores from progress bits and locator publication; stopped exclusive helper may replay only idempotent control fields from immutable intent, not allocation/destruction or collector-updated root payload.

Keep pending root cell safe false; old frozen source view covers GC until canonical root-admission accepts current value. Slot owns initialized scan contract before close; final commit publishes only control after full root/metadata validation.

Observed exit, close request, join error or timeout is not quiescence. Actual generated normal/nonlocal exit or verified thread/helper drain produces separate no-future/no-inflight control and data receipts before helper/recycle.

Claim header atomic encoding and generation limits, release/acquire publication and plain-field exclusion; async owner-death help needs qualified lock-free header or explicit platform stop. Portable mutex fallback admits only covered cooperative exits.

Generated caller already holds bounded origin slot/generation, complete mapped source and durable bind serial; no origin discovered by FP/thread ID/callsite; initial entry/host permits must be separately admitted.
Anchor persists outside GSTATE teardown; check slot/session/VM generation before reading VM pointer; lifetime pin before dereference; fixed VM capacity and checked counters, no historical VM map.
ACK closes one exact extra origin lease only after canonical root/effect custody; retain physical view pin through readers/borrowers. Never clear natural Scheme slot/map or restored-parent pin.
Actual selected CFUN lacks cleanup body; outer run/call catcher and native guard must transfer source view/key and close future publication before unwind; dynamic-wind alone is insufficient.

Registry close and root acceptance linearize in one domain; frozen complete caller view covers closed-round deferral. Snapshot membership and relocation exclusion cannot be inferred from release/acquire alone.

Separate prepared capacity, stable routing descriptors, bound native children and committed collector members. Current processor_count drives barrier and GC partitioning; changing it needs a real generation transition, not a renamed scalar.

orders.orderContract: Close future control/data authority and drain both in-flight sets before exclusive helper; no release from owner-exit observation or failed join.

orders.rejectedShortcut: Async recovery needs qualified atomic/header/platform stop; general portable C fallback does not promise fault-tolerant progress.
